name: yon-write
description: YON Writing & Compilation Mode. Use when creating, generating, converting, or writing YON content. Triggers on: "write YON", "convert to YON", "create a .yon file", "encode this as YON", "YON format", or any request where the expected output is YON records. Also triggers when unstructured content should be structured into YON even without explicit keyword — e.g., working in a YON project. Use yon-read instead when reading, interpreting, explaining, or summarizing existing YON.
